svg.title: Why you confirm who is speaking
svg.desc: A short made-up interview with two speakers, A and B. QualSafe notices that A asks the questions and proposes that A is the interviewer and B the participant. You confirm or correct that. Once you do, the interviewer's lines are set apart with a grey veil and the participant's lines get a purple bar, because the participant's words are what you code.

text.tspan: A: How has your first term gone?
B: Busy, but I like my classes.
B: Paying for books. It adds up.
QualSafe looks at who asks the questions.
It proposes who is the interviewer.
You confirm it, or correct it.
The participant's words are the ones you code.
